articles.title: Hurricane Nolo: Slow, Strong, and Soaking Hawaii
articles.summary: Hurricane Nolo is moving at just 5 mph toward Hawaii. It may not make landfall, but forecasters warn of up to 2 feet of rain and "catastrophic flooding" on the Big Island.

articles.title: Nor'easter Turns Streets into Rivers, Cancels Concerts Across the Northeast
articles.summary: A powerful nor'easter flooded New York and New Jersey on Saturday, cutting power to 100,000+ homes and cancelling 1,199 flights. A full moon made the coastal flooding even worse.

articles.title: Trump Rolls Back Fuel Economy Rules, Sparking Debate Over Cars and Climate
articles.summary: President Trump announced new fuel economy standards that reverse Biden-era rules. He says it will lower car prices, but the old rules aimed to cut emissions and save fuel.
